origins.neoorigins.abyssal.name: Abyssal
origins.neoorigins.abyssal.description: A e kere eke nke miri - armored, ngwa ngwa na mmiri, na ike na-akpọ ndị nlekọta allies. Ji nwayọọ nwayọọ na nkụ n'ala.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_water_breathing: Na-eku ume mmiri dị ka ikuku ma na-ahụ nke ọma site na ya n'enweghị igwe ojii.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_underwater_mini: Ebe a na-egwupụta ogbunigwe na-agba ọsọ mgbe mmiri na-emikpu.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_depth_strider.d: Na-aga ngwa ngwa site na mmiri.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_swim_speed.name: Mmiri mepere emepe
power.neoorigins.aquatic_swim_speed.desc: Na-egwu mmiri siri ike pụọ n'ala oké osimiri, ọ bụghị naanị n'akụkụ ya.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_buoyancy.name: Nnọpụiche Mmanya
power.neoorigins.aquatic_buoyancy.descri: Na-ejide omimi mgbe imikpu mmiri zuru oke kama imikpu. Igwu mmiri ka na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet.name: Pescivore
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet.descr: Enwere ike iri azụ naanị. Ndị nchịkwa sava nwere ike gbanyụọ nke a na nhazi (ocean_origins.fish_diet_required).
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet_bonus: Raw cod na salmon na-eri nri dị ka ụdị esi esi ya.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_aquatic_speed.d: Na-agafe mmiri nwere ọrịa strok siri ike, nke na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma - ngwa ngwa karịa onye bi n'elu.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_night_vision.de: Anya emegharịrị ka ọ bụrụ ọchịchịrị zuru oke. Jiri igodo ọhụụ abalị tụgharịa (nke ndabara K).
power.neoorigins.abyssal_thorns_aura.des: Na-eweghachite 30% nke mmebi mebiri n'aka ndị mwakpo.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_natural_armor.d: +2 obi (+4 max HP). Usoro ihe ọmụmụ ihe omimi nke oke osimiri na-ewulite etiti siri ike karị.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_underwater_mini: Ebe a na-egwupụta ogbunigwe na-agba ọsọ ọbụlagodi mgbe mmiri kpuru ya.
Na-agwọ ọrịa nke nta nke nta ka ọ nọ na mmiri - ihe dịka 1 HP kwa sekọnd atọ ọ bụla.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_daylight_damage: Na-enweta mmebi 1.5 kwa nkeji mgbe ìhè anyanwụ kpugheere ya.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_dries_out.name: Na-akpọnwụ
power.neoorigins.abyssal_dries_out.descr: Ikuku na-ada mgbe ị na-apụ na mmiri: elu dị ogologo karịa ma ị kubie ume. Mmiri ozuzo, ite mmiri, iku ume mmiri ma ọ bụ ọwa mmiri na-arụ ọrụ dị nso na-egbochi ya.
origins.neoorigins.voidwalker.name: Voidwalker
origins.neoorigins.voidwalker.descriptio: Ọgwụgwụ metụrụ ya aka - usoro site na ngọngọ, na-anya obere anya ma na-ejegharị n'ọtụtụ egwu egwu anaghị ahụ ya. Sprints na-enweghị ike ọgwụgwụ, ma mmiri na-egbu mgbu.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_active_telep: Blinks na ebe ị na-ele anya (ruo ngọngọ 24). Na-efu ike 2. 80-akara aka cooldown.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_night_vision: Enwere ike ịhụ n'ọchịchịrị zuru oke. Jiri igodo ọhụụ abalị tụgharịa (nke ndabara K).
Ndị na-eme mkpọtụ anaghị achọpụta ọnụnọ gị ọ gwụla ma ị wakporo ha.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_water_damage: Na-ewere mmebi 1 kwa nkeji mgbe ọ nọ na mmiri ma ọ bụ mmiri ozuzo - ihe efu na-atụ egwu mmiri.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_no_hunger_sp: Sprinting anaghị akwụ ụgwọ agụụ ọzọ.
origins.neoorigins.stoneguard.name: Nkume nche
origins.neoorigins.stoneguard.descriptio: A mụrụ site na nkume dị ndụ - onye sentinel a na-apụghị ịma jijiji nke na-awụsa ndị na-awakpo ogwu ogwu, na-eji aka efu na-egwupụta ogbunigwe, na-etinyekwa ọkụ na-egbuke egbuke n'ime ọchịchịrị. Ala dị nwayọọ, mana nke na-adịghị emegharị ahụ adịghị ahapụ ha.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_natural_armo: + 3 obi (+6 max HP). Otu nkume na-ejide karịa anụ ahụ.
Na-eweghachi 20% nke mmebi nke ndị mwakpo nwetara.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_stone_mining: Na-agbaji ngọngọ ugboro abụọ ọsọ ọsọ.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_no_mob_spawn: Nnukwu anụ anaghị amụ n'ime ngọngọ 48.
origins.neoorigins.verdant.name: Verdant
origins.neoorigins.verdant.description: Ọdịdị dị ndụ nke ụwa akwụkwọ ndụ akwụkwọ ndụ - na-agwụ ike, na udo na anụ ọhịa, ma nrụrụ nke Nether mebiri kpamkpam.
power.neoorigins.verdant_mobs_ignore.des: Ìgwè mmadụ niile - gụnyere ndị iro - na-eleghara gị anya ma ọ bụrụ na a kpasuru gị iwe.
Mgbọrọgwụ na-ekpuchi ọdịda ọ bụla. Anaghị emebi ọdịda ọdịda.
power.neoorigins.verdant_no_hunger_sprin: Sprinting anaghị akwụ ụgwọ agụụ ọzọ.
power.neoorigins.verdant_forest_regen.de: Ji nwayọọ nwayọọ na-eweghachi ahụ ike mgbe ọ nọ n'ime ọhịa.
power.neoorigins.verdant_nether_damage.d: Na-ewere mmebi 2 kwa nkeji mgbe ọ nọ na Nether. Akpụkpọ ụkwụ Frost Walker na-egbochi mmebi ahụ kpamkpam.
origins.neoorigins.umbral.name: Umbral
origins.neoorigins.umbral.description: Nwa nke onyinyo - na-atụgharị orbs nke ike gbara ọchịchịrị, na-akụtu n'etiti ọnọdụ, na-atụgharị akụ. Ngwa ngwa n'ọchịchịrị, ọkụ anwụ na-agba.
power.neoorigins.umbral_night_vision.des: Ọ na-ahụ nke ọma n'ọchịchịrị zuru oke. Jiri igodo ọhụụ abalị tụgharịa (nke ndabara K).
power.neoorigins.umbral_active_dash.name: Dash onyinyo
power.neoorigins.umbral_active_dash.desc: Na-aga n'ihu na oke ọsọ n'ụzọ ị na-aga. Na-efu ike 2. 60-akara aka cooldown.
Na-emebi 1 n'otu nkeji mgbe ìhè anyanwụ na-ekpuchi ya.
power.neoorigins.umbral_projectile_immun: Àkụ́ na-agafe n'enweghị ihe ọ bụla site n'ụdị nke onyinyo metụrụ aka.
power.neoorigins.umbral_no_hunger_sprint: Sprinting anaghị akwụ ụgwọ agụụ ọzọ.
power.neoorigins.umbral_shadow_orb.name: Onyunyo Orb
power.neoorigins.umbral_shadow_orb.descr: Tinye orb na-adịghị ahụ anya nke na-adaba radius mgbochi 28 n'ime Ọchịchịrị. Ruo 4 orbs na-arụ ọrụ n'otu oge; idobe nke ọhụrụ na-ewepụ nke kacha ochie. Na-efu ike 2. 60-akara aka cooldown.
power.neoorigins.feline_active_launch.de: Na-atụba gị ike n'ụzọ ị na-achọ. Na-efu ike 2. 4-nkeji nke abụọ.
power.neoorigins.draconic_flight.name: Dragọn Wings
power.neoorigins.draconic_flight.descrip: Na-eji nku draconic dị ike na-efegharị n'ikuku kpamkpam.
power.neoorigins.draconic_active_firebal: Na-eku ume nke obere bọọlụ ọkụ anọ n'ụzọ ị na-ele. Na-eri ume 3. 4-nkeji nke abụọ.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_crop_growth.name: Ngọzi okike
power.neoorigins.sylvan_crop_growth.desc: Ihe ọkụkụ dị nso na-eto ngwa ngwa n'ihu gị, dịka a ga-asị na ala gọziri.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_active_root.name: Njikọ
power.neoorigins.sylvan_active_root.desc: Mgbọrọgwụ ihe niile e kere eke dị nso n'ebe nwere ike Slowness VI maka 4 sekọnd. Na-efu 2 vitality. 200-akara aka cooldown.
power.neoorigins.revenant_active_phase.d: Na-agafe mgbidi siri ike n'ụzọ ị na-achọ. 3-nkeji oyi.
power.neoorigins.revenant_active_bolt.de: Na-agba ọkụ nke ike na-akpọnwụ nke na-agbawa n'ime mpaghara alụlụ ọjọọ. Na-efu 1 ume. 4-nkeji nke abụọ.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_starting_triden: Enyere onye trident siri ike siri ike (Mending, Unbreaking III, Riptide III) mgbe ịhọrọ mmalite a.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_scare_ocean.des: Anụ ọhịa na-agafe agafe - squid, azụ, dolphins - gbanarị gị n'ihu.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_active_phase: Gaa na mgbidi siri ike n'ụzọ ị na-achọ. Na-efu ike 3. 80-akara aka cooldown.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_active_glows: Na-edobe ngọngọ nkume na-egbuke egbuke n'elu ị na-ele anya. 100-akara aka cooldown.
power.neoorigins.verdant_harvest_bonus.d: Ịkụjisị ihe ọkụkụ ma ọ bụ osisi tozuru okè na-ewepụta otu ntụtụ nke ọzọ.
item.neoorigins.orb_of_origin.not_enough: Ị chọrọ ọkwa ahụmịhe %s iji jiri nke a.
jei.neoorigins.orb_of_origin.info: Tọgharịa nhọrọ mmalite niile wee mepee onye ahọpụtara mmalite. Ọ na-efu ọkwa 5 XP kwa ojiji gara aga (ojiji mbụ bụ n'efu). Eriri na ojiji.
emi.neoorigins.orb_of_origin.info: Tọgharịa nhọrọ mmalite niile wee mepee onye ahọpụtara mmalite. Ọ na-efu ọkwa 5 XP kwa ojiji gara aga (ojiji mbụ bụ n'efu). Eriri na ojiji.
item.neoorigins.orb_of_class.not_enough_: Ị chọrọ ọkwa ahụmịhe %s iji jiri nke a.
jei.neoorigins.orb_of_class.info: Na-atọgharịa naanị nhọrọ klaasị gị wee mepee onye na-ahọrọ klaasị, na-edobe isi mmalite gị. Na-eri 2 XP ọkwa kwa ojiji. Eriri na ojiji.
emi.neoorigins.orb_of_class.info: Na-atọgharịa naanị nhọrọ klaasị gị wee mepee onye na-ahọrọ klaasị, na-edobe isi mmalite gị. Na-eri 2 XP ọkwa kwa ojiji. Eriri na ojiji.
origins.neoorigins.inchling.name: Inchling
origins.neoorigins.inchling.description: Mmadụ ruru nkeji iri na ise nke na-atụ mgbidi ahụ n'ụzọ dị mfe ma na-agba ọsọ na-eju anya - mana ahụ adịghị ike na-abịa na mpaghara ahụ.
power.neoorigins.inchling_size.name: Nke dị ntakịrị
power.neoorigins.inchling_size.descripti: Naanị otu ụzọ n'ụzọ anọ nke nha nkịtị.
Nwere ike ịrapara na tụọ elu ọ bụla.
power.neoorigins.inchling_no_fall_damage: Ya mere, ìhè nke ịda ada adịghị afụ ụfụ.
power.neoorigins.inchling_reduced_health: -5 obi (-10 max HP). Otu akụkụ anọ na-ejide ntaramahụhụ ahụ.
power.neoorigins.inchling_speed_boost.de: Na-eme 15% ngwa ngwa karịa ka nkịtị.
power.neoorigins.inchling_hunger_efficie: Agụụ na-agụ ọkara ngwa ngwa dịka onye ọkpụkpọ nkịtị.
origins.neoorigins.sporeling.name: Ịgba egwu
origins.neoorigins.sporeling.description: Ihe e kere eke nke fungal nke na-eme nke ọma n'ọchịchịrị na ubi ero - nke nwere spores na-egbu egbu, mana ìhè anyanwụ akpọnwụwo.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_spore_cloud.d: Na-agbapụta spore projectile nke na-adaba n'ígwé ojii nke spores na-egbu egbu. Na-efu 3 vitality. 12-sekọnd cooldown.
Enwere ike ịhụ nke ọma n'ọchịchịrị zuru oke. Jiri igodo ọhụụ abalị tụgharịa (nke ndabara K).
